caption: The drawing consists of a large square divided diagonally from the bottom left corner to the top right corner. The upper left triangle of the square contains a grid composed of nine smaller squares arranged in a 3x3 pattern. Each smaller square is divided diagonally into two triangles; one triangle is colored green with a small grid texture, and the other triangle is off-white with a purple geometric pattern. The placement alternates so that the off-white triangles form a pattern across the grid. The lower right triangle of the large square is filled with a dense pattern of diagonal gray pencil lines intersecting to form a crosshatched texture, with a lighter background beneath. The background of the entire drawing is plain and off-white or beige, and there is faint handwriting and markings in the lower left corner.
title: Quilt Block
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
